items.title: Base completes Cobalt upgrade, adds new tools for tokenized assets
items.summary: Base’s Cobalt lets traders set transaction conditions while giving issuers tools for compliance checks, stock splits and forced token transfers.

items.title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
items.summary: An Ethereum security researcher estimates about 0.36 ETH in rewards was diverted, while precautionary exits cover validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH.

items.title: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed
items.summary: Highly liquid and settling 24/7, stablecoins can leave banks and countries at lightning speed. But whether stablecoins are a risk — or an opportunity — depends on your perspective.

items.title: Chainalysis beats most Celsius claims, but ‘audit’ lawsuit survives
items.summary: Chainalysis still faces an aiding-and-abetting claim over Celsius’ disputed $3.3 billion audit after a judge dismissed 15 other claims.

items.title: Metaplanet directors push back against shareholder fury over a controversial executive payout plan
items.summary: Independent directors cite management’s financial risk and restructuring role, but leave questions about Gerovich’s exercised shares and MMXX Ventures unanswered.

items.title: OpenAI seeks $30 billion in funding at whopping $1.4 trillion valuation after delaying IPO
items.summary: The ChatGPT maker is pursuing fresh funding after delaying its public listing, while expanding its AI tools despite mounting safety concerns.

items.title: How European investors can now buy bitcoin without taking on U.S. dollar risk
items.summary: Asset management platform HANetf has listed ETCs in London, Frankfurt and Paris providing pound sterling and euro-hedged exposure to bitcoin.

items.title: Live Updates: Bitcoin flat near $84,000 after closing out best quarter since 2024
items.summary: After a spike higher overnight, interest rates are dipping ahead of tomorrow's key U.S. employment report.

items.title: Illinois agrees to six-month delay of crypto tax as industry continues court battle
items.summary: Both sides agreed the 0.2% tax should be put off until July 1, if the court approves the deal, which will let the state and industry focus on the legal dispute.

items.title: Crypto lost $1.26 billion in hacks while bitcoin bulls enjoyed a monster quarter
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 1, 2026

items.title: Synthetic tokenized stocks are bad for American investors
items.summary: U.S. markets are the envy of the world because investors trust that whoever owns a share owns it fully, writes Aaron Kaplan, founder of Promethum. The synthetic models cheapens that trust, shortchanges U.S. investors, and undercuts the issuer-led capital markets model.

items.title: Bitcoin kicks off new quarter in the old $82,000-$85,000 price range
items.summary: Prices briefly topped $85,000 on Wednesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation cooled bets on Fed rate hikes, But bulls couldn’t hold the move and spot ETFs didn’t help.

items.title: Citigroup raises 12-month bitcoin target to $113,000 as ETF inflows resume
items.summary: Citi also raised its 12-month target for ether from from $2,240 to $3,028.

items.title: Dogecoin gets DeFi testnet as DogeOS bets miners will eventually secure its apps
items.summary: DogeOS wants to turn DOGE into more than a payments and speculation asset, but its applications still rely on selected operators rather than Dogecoin miners.

items.title: Bitcoin's soft-inflation pop to $85,500 fades as bond yields refuse to fall
items.summary: A cooler-than-expected PCE report sent bitcoin briefly above $85,000 on Wednesday. Treasury yields held near their highest since 2002 and the gains drained away.

items.title: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B
items.summary: Crypto security losses reached $1.26 billion in Q3 across 247 incidents, with September alone accounting for roughly $769 million.

items.title: LATAM stablecoin liquidity may depend on few providers, investor says
items.summary: Researchers in a Latin American stablecoin ecosystem report warned “fragility in the system is concentrated in its thinnest layer,” with just 16 of 494 companies focused primarily on wholesale liquidity, treasury and credit.

items.title: Tokenized assets don’t always mirror traditional markets, Dune finds
items.summary: Dune found that tokenized markets show different trading patterns from traditional markets, with RWA value reaching $34.5 billion.

items.title: Bitcoin trapped below $86K as PCE changes cloud inflation reading
items.summary: Bitcoin erased its post-PCE gains as analysts cautioned that methodology changes complicated the lower-than-expected inflation reading.
